purpose: Teach: 大卒/常駐/還流/短絡/受話器/取り引き/改名/おもに

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、大卒採用の比率も考慮されてますね
lines.en: The police do take university graduate hiring ratios into consideration.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact opening. Steady, measured pace. Professional but not distant. Slight emphasis on 'do' — acknowledging the questioner's observation without unnecessary warmth.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、重要施設に警察官を常駐させてらっしゃるんですね
lines.en: Yes — and the police station keeps officers permanently stationed at important facilities, don't you.
lines.style: Attentive nod in the voice. Warm agreement without obsequiousness. Slight lift at the end — genuine curiosity, not just confirming what was said.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、海外不正資金の還流ルートを捜査します
lines.en: The police investigate the routes that illegal overseas funds take when they're being repatriated.
lines.style: Precise, procedural tone. Even cadence. Each phrase lands cleanly. No apology in the delivery — simply stating operational fact.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、短絡的な事件断定を避けてらっしゃいますね
lines.en: Yes — and the police are careful to avoid jumping to conclusions about cases before the facts are clear.
lines.style: Respectful, steady. Leans forward slightly in the voice. Acknowledging the care taken in investigation without fawning.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、緊急の受話器対応を整備しております
lines.en: We've set up systems to respond to emergency calls promptly and properly.
lines.style: Shift to 'we' — inclusive, takes ownership. Quiet pride in the infrastructure. Crisp, direct. No elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、不正取り引きの摘発、頼もしいです
lines.en: Yes — the work the police do busting illegal trading operations is really reassuring.
lines.style: Sincere warmth. Slow enough to let the appreciation land. Not flattery — genuine relief in the voice.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪組織が改名しても追跡を続けます
lines.en: Even when criminal organizations change their names, we stay on their trail.
lines.style: Quiet determination. 'We' ownership again. Slow, resolved pace. Understated confidence — not a boast, a statement of discipline.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、当署はおもに地域防犯を担当ですね
lines.en: Yes — and our station's main focus is local crime prevention in the community.
lines.style: Warm, closer now. Shift to 'our' — claiming belonging. Slight exhale of relief. Familiar but still respectful.
